name: plan-studio help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:plan-studio. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Preview
entries.text: Shows the plan as it'll read.

entries.title: Remove link
entries.text: Removes link. Depending on your behaviour theme it asks first. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Go
entries.text: Runs it.

entries.title: Set up AI
entries.text: Connects Claude so you can edit plans in plain English.

entries.title: Plan
entries.text: Which plan.

entries.title: One line about it
entries.text: A short sentence on what the plan is.

entries.title: Category
entries.text: Where the plan is filed, like Builds > Console.

entries.title: Template
entries.text: Start from a ready-made outline.

entries.title: Save anyway
entries.text: Saves anyway. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Save and open
entries.text: Saves the plan and opens it.

entries.title: Tree
entries.text: Plans by category, as a tree.

entries.title: Sub-grids
entries.text: One grid per category.

entries.title: Coverage
entries.text: Which apps and plugins have plans and which don't.

entries.title: Look again (new plugins and apps appear by themselves)
entries.text: Shows “Look again (new plugins and apps appear by themselves)”. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Gaps
entries.text: What has no plan yet.

entries.title: Planned
entries.text: Plans not built yet.

entries.title: Gone
entries.text: Shows “Gone”. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: A new plan instead
entries.text: Shows “A new plan instead”. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Plan this
entries.text: Starts a plan for this gap.

entries.title: Add to a plan
entries.text: Adds this to an existing plan.

entries.title: Add a planned feature
entries.text: Adds a planned feature. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Back to plans
entries.text: Back to the list.

entries.title: Talk
entries.text: Talk the plan through out loud with AmberX.

entries.title: Save as a new plan anyway
entries.text: Saves as a new plan anyway. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Keep editing
entries.text: Back to the editor; nothing is lost.

entries.title: Summary
entries.text: What the plan is, in a few lines.

entries.title: Goal
entries.text: What done looks like.

entries.title: Priority
entries.text: How soon it matters.

entries.title: Build profile
entries.text: Which profile it'll be built in.

entries.title: Project
entries.text: Where you set “Project”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Owner
entries.text: Where you set “Owner”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Target date
entries.text: When you'd like it done.

entries.title: Tags
entries.text: Where you set “Tags”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Duplicate
entries.text: Makes a copy of the plan.

entries.title: Save as template
entries.text: Saves as template. Nothing is kept until you tap it. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Add link
entries.text: Adds link. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Write
entries.text: Back to writing the plan.

entries.title: Open the orchestrator
entries.text: Opens the build this plan turned into.

entries.title: Check progress
entries.text: How far its build has got.

entries.title: Preview steps
entries.text: Shows the steps the orchestrator would split it into, before you commit.

entries.title: Turn into a build
entries.text: Sends the plan to the Build orchestrator. Only then does it become a build.

entries.title: Restore v
entries.text: Restores v. What is there now is kept in the history. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Add comment
entries.text: Adds a comment to the plan.

entries.title: Plan Studio
entries.text: Its settings.

entries.title: Quick capture
entries.text: Jots a plan down in one line; file it later.

entries.title: Autosave saved plans while editing
entries.text: Where you set “Autosave saved plans while editing”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Apply small AI edits straight away (with Undo)
entries.text: Where you set “Apply small AI edits straight away (with Undo)”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Plan on the banner
entries.text: Shows the plan you're on in the banner.

entries.title: New plan
entries.text: Starts an empty plan.

entries.title: New from a template
entries.text: Starts a plan from a ready-made outline.

entries.title: Save this view
entries.text: Keeps these filters and this layout so you can come back to them.

entries.title: Export (selected, or all) as Markdown
entries.text: Exports (selected, or all) as Markdown. Keep it or share it. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Export as JSON
entries.text: Exports as JSON. Keep it or share it. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Tag
entries.text: Shows “Tag”. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Previous plan
entries.text: Goes to the previous plan. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: Next plan
entries.text: Goes to the next plan. Part of Plan Studio.

entries.title: here · in all
entries.text: Shows “here · in all”. Part of Plan Studio.
